edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Tuan Lim Guan Eng asked the Minister of Defense to state Malaysia's position following the AUKUS defense alliance where Australia will buy eight nuclear war submarines worth AUD368 billion and the impact on the security of ASEAN countries based on the Zone of Peace Freedom and Neutrality or ZOPFAN and whether 8 nuclear war submarines will be allowed to operate in the waters of ASEAN countries.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I have to give this question for the answer.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I don't want to say off the cuff afraid that there will be a wrong word that I use
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: because this involves the issue of the relationship of many countries and also security.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: I request permission for me to read the answer.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, on 13 March 2023 recently, the Prime Minister of Australia, the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom and the President of the United States announced the progress status of the implementation of the AUKUS three-way security agreement.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Before the announcement was made, the Commander of the Australian Armed Forces who is the special envoy of the Prime Minister of Australia came to the office to meet with me, giving an explanation on 9 March 2023 that the development of eight nuclear-powered submarines only uses nuclear-powered engines
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: and will not be equipped with nuclear weapons in line with Australia's commitment under the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons ( NPT ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This explanation was followed by a telephone call from the United States Secretary of Defense on 10 March 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Finally, recently the meeting session of the Minister of State at the United Kingdom's Ministry of Defense on 28 March 2023 came to the MINDEF office.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: During the information session Mr. Speaker, I have explained that Malaysia's stance and principles in relation to AUKUS are permanent and unchanged.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Where, Malaysia urges all relevant parties whether inside or outside of AUKUS to respect each other and fully comply with the existing national legal and international legislation instruments, especially in relation to the operation of nuclear-powered submarines in the country's waters.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This includes instruments under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea ( UNCLOS ),
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: the Southeast Asian Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone Agreement or with the permission of Southeast Asia Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone ( SEANWFZ )
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: and the ASEAN Declaration as Zone of Peace, Freedom and Neutrality ( ZOPFAN ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: As a member of ASEAN Mr. Speaker, Malaysia holds the principle to maintain ASEAN as a Safe, Free, and Exceptive Zone.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This includes issues related to the acceleration of nuclear weapons, the prevention of nuclear proliferation, and the use of nuclear technology peacefully.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: In order to ensure the safety and sovereignty of the country and stability in the region remains preserved, Malaysia urges all parties whether inside or outside of this AUKUS alliance to not carry out any provocative activities that can interfere with order and security in the region.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: However, Malaysia always respects the rights of all countries to improve their respective defense capabilities or their respective capacity building, taking into account their respective wishes and interests.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, based on the international law of UNCLOS 1982 which reads, any ship or aircraft is given freedom of navigation or flight or freedom of navigation or overflight in the last sea or in an exclusive economic zone in any country but subject.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: The activity must comply with the rules and laws of coastal countries as long as it is not against UNCLOS 1982.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: `` 1010 UNCLOS 1982 also states that any submarine that passes through other countries' regions must always be on the surface of the water.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: It can not dive, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: It must pass on the surface of the water and this rule applies in our country as well as other persisiran countries in Southeast Asia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Even so, if there is a foreign submarine, whether conventional or nuclear power that wants to sail under the surface of the water in the country's waters,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: the Navy of the foreign country he wants to travel must submit an application to the Royal Malaysian Navy first through a diplomatic note to obtain special approval.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This rule also applies if there is a submarine or warship that wants to enter any port in our country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Honorable Bagan.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Thank you to the Honorable Minister for giving a very complete explanation of an issue that is very important for the future and also national security.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: I would like to ask the Honorable Minister who stated earlier that permission must be obtained from the country
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: if there is a submarine of any country that passes through the waters of our country.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Can you tell this honorable House how many times permission has been given and from which country?
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: The most important thing is that since the Honorable mentioned earlier that this nuclear submarine is only for his engine, not for his weapon.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: However, as informed by the Honorable Minister
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: and also the lively discussions and debates that take place in Australia, it is stated that it will be equipped with nuclear weapons, even though they have given assurances.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Does the Honorable Minister plan to hold a meeting with all ASEAN Defense Ministers so that if we agree more effectively to urge all external powers?
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Don't play nuclear and nuclear weapons in the ASEAN region
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: so that we can stick to the concept of Zone of Peace, Freedom and Neutrality.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: : Mr. Speaker, regarding the permission to go through the waters of our country, all this time any voyages, especially submarines from our allied countries, especially in the FPDA,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: which is the Five Power Defense Arrangements
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: which Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Malaysia and Singapore are its members who have already exceeded 60 years.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: All the permissions were found
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: The power is nuclear power
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: but it has its weapon still conventionally.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This is described so detailed by the three countries, the Commander of the Armed Forces ( Chief of Defense Forces ) from Australia who is a special ambassador to represent the Prime Minister of Australia, explaining in detail that even the Navy or the Australian side can not modify, can not open it has the nuclear box.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: It can not open and it is unlikely to be opened to be modified.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: This is a very strict SOP that they need to monitor and they need to follow.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Regarding the consultation or discussion between the counterparts of the Defense Ministers of ASEAN countries, we already have a schedule to hold a meeting and Indonesia will host
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: which will be held in July.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: However, you have to look at it
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: because the host said in July, don't know when the time is set.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: There later, this is one of the agendas that we will discuss and this ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting ( ADMM ), we will invite what is called additional countries, six countries
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: including the United States and Australia to discuss this matter, what is called ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting Plus ( ADMM-Plus ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: We will discuss.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: It is certain that the planning to establish this AUKUS will be the main topic in our discussion later in Jakarta.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: God willing, thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Tuan Lim Guan Eng [Bagan]

edus.text: Dear Kota Bharu.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: I am interested in the title that has been presented today
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: and I read some articles about the AUKUS, Australia, UK and US defense alliance.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: According to one article, one of the reasons why Australia requires this submarine
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: is because they think about the presence of the Chinese Navy, especially in the South China Sea.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: So, I would like to ask what is the view of our Malaysian Government and what steps are taken?
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: The important thing is to ensure the defense and security of our country Malaysia itself.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
addressees: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: Thank you friends from Kota Bharu.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, regarding what many parties say that the establishment of AUKUS is due to the existence of other powers in this area.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: That's outside of us having power
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: because the establishment of AUKUS is the policy of the United States
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: and also Western countries regarding their presence and peace in the Indo-Pacific.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: They see not only in ASEAN but also in the Indo-Pacific where they want to see that this area continues to remain a peaceful area.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: So, this is the capacity building as I mentioned earlier countries to improve their defense base.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: Their defense base is outside of us having power, Mr. Speaker, that's why each has a thing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: We are also improving our defense assets, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: However, this is their policy to see that the wider Indo-Pacific area.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Not only in the South China Sea
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: but including to the Pacific and other countries.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: So, this is their policy
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: and we still remain as mentioned by Yang Berhormat Bagan earlier, ASEAN will continue to decide.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: This is our policy that in Southeast Asia we want to remain so that it becomes an area where there is no nuclear weaponry or nuclear use used in this area.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: We do have a joint decision.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: The ASEAN consensus, Mr. Speaker, is that we want to maintain this Zone of Peace, Freedom and Neutrality ( ZOPFAN ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: So, there is no question of saying that we are arguing with anyone.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.text: ASEAN, we are a neutral zone.

edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]

edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: They must ask for permission from countries whose waters want to pass
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: if they want to pass.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pertahanan [Dato’ Seri Utama Mohamad bin Haji Hasan]
addressees: Datuk Seri Takiyuddin bin Hassan [Kota Bharu]

edus.text: But there is no such thing

edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, until now we have 103 health clinics equipped with this TPC–OCHIS system and 42 health clinics in Negeri Sembilan will be equipped with the same system through the National EMR Project as I mentioned earlier.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: There are 1,027 health clinics that use online appointment systems through MySejahtera.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, 370 health clinics offer virtual clinic services ( virtual clinics ) to their customers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: The next plan is to expand, God willing, all related systems more comprehensively to achieve the objectives of an integrated health information system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, this EMR system is actually a good initiative, where it can integrate the information and history of a patient's illness.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I give an example, I am due to a career factor ...
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Go straight to the question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: I want to give a background so that the Honorable Minister can understand.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: I went to Kluang Hospital, I filled out a form.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Then I moved to Johor Bahru Hospital, I had to repeat it and the doctor had to waste time asking about the history of my illness.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, to what extent - because I saw the Honorable Minister earlier saying that since 2005 we already have this system.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, to what extent can this system fully integrate?
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: What are the constraints and challenges faced causing until today I still see every hospital working in Silo.
edus.speaker: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Bakri.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Indeed, this is our dream.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Finally, one day, all patients can actually keep them with their own medical records.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: When they go to any clinic, they can release their data.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, actually to answer that, we- as many as this, only 27.5 percent of hospitals have a general patient management system and only 9.5 percent of health clinics, another 4.4 percent of dental clinics that have the system I mentioned earlier TPC - OCHIS.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, our main challenge is actually to get or provide this comprehensive digitization, we need a very high budget, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: The budget can sometimes reach billions.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, why is this implementation - what actually contributes to the high budget is
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: because it needs infrastructure upgrades.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, buildings also need to be suitable
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: if we want to use this digitization system, with its wiring and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Then, equipment.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Sometimes our equipment is old equipment.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, we have to upgrade the equipment by either repairing it
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: or we have to find a new one.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: That also contributes to the high budget needs.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Of course, the others are the system itself, the system, then the cloud system and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: So, this is what sometimes means we also need of course, finally this complete implementation or the universal thing moving forward, we also need from the cooperation of the Ministry of Finance, God willing.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Tan Hong Pin [Bakri]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: We are confident that medical records or HIS can help reduce congestion in hospitals, especially in emergency units
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: and also in health clinics.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: However, it does not mean that
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: if there is a shortage of doctors and medical staff, they will not be able to accommodate a large number of patients.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, I would like to ask here.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: What is the justification when the Madani Government through the Public Service Department no longer sponsors any scholarships for critical fields such as medicine, pharmacy, dentistry and nursing?
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: We know that the cost of medicine is too high.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: We are confident that this will reduce the ability of the Malays to continue medical fields and in the long term will reduce the number of doctors from the Malay race.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: Yes, I agree.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: Actually, that's why I say that whatever problems we face in the ministry, it is not a problem that is only burdened
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: and burdened on the shoulders of the Malaysian Ministry of Health.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: It needs an integrated collaboration between JPA, also MOF, I also include it in our ecosystem for the preparation of the doctor,
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: we also need to cooperate with the Ministry of Higher Education trained doctors.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: So, I think that needs to be discussed thoroughly and I agree.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: God willing, I am concerned about this and we will look forward, what is the best thing we can implement to ensure that our ecosystem in this health service, especially doctors and also these health workers is taken seriously by all.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dato' Dr. Zulkafperi bin Hanapi [Tanjong Karang]

edus.text: Honorable members, now the session for Minister's Question Time is over today.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you. [ Minister's Question Time session ends ]
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: everyone
